name: Abuja
subtitle: Abuja, capital of Nigeria: its numbers, a short history and places to see beyond the World Heritage list.

keyPoints.text: The Federal Capital Territory registered 1,406,239 people in the 2006 census (projected at over 3 million in 2022).

items.label: residents in the Federal Capital Territory, 2006

blocks.prompt: About how many people lived in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) in the 2006 census?

parts.text: 1,406,239 in the FCT (776,298 in the Abuja Municipal Area Council) during the 2006 census by the National Population Commission of Nigeria.
